tasks.label: 🚀 Start Harrix Swiss Knife
args: $flag = Join-Path '${workspaceFolder}' 'temp\hsk-resume-after-uv-upgrade.flag'; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $flag)) { exit 0 }; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $flag -Force; $py = Join-Path '${workspaceFolder}' '.venv\Scripts\python.exe'; $main = Join-Path '${workspaceFolder}' 'src\harrix_swiss_knife\main.py'; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $py)) { Write-Error "Missing $py"; exit 1 }; & $py $main
